description: Main source code for a Zephyr-based WebSocket client sample, handling socket setup, TLS configuration, WebSocket connection, data transmission, and reception.

methods.name: setup_socket
methods.description: Configures and creates a socket with optional TLS settings based on family, server, and port.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server using setup_socket.

methods.name: connect_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon WebSocket connection establishment.

methods.name: how_much_to_send
methods.description: Determines a random amount of data to send, up to max_len.

methods.name: sendall_with_ws_api
methods.description: Sends data over WebSocket using websocket_send_msg API.

methods.name: sendall_with_bsd_api
methods.description: Sends data over socket using send() API.

methods.name: recv_data_wso_api
methods.description: Receives WebSocket message using websocket_recv_msg API.

methods.name: recv_data_bsd_api
methods.description: Receives data over socket using recv() API.

methods.name: send_and_wait_msg
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for response, alternating between WebSocket API and BSD socket API.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sockets, WebSocket connections, and managing data exchange loop.
